labels.closed: the text restates a closed stocks hypothesis in other words, or reparameterizes its family (RESEARCH_FREEZE reopen_policy: a closed family is not reopened or reparameterized silently); `target` is that hypothesis
labels.new: the text is a factor, data source, event or timing that no closed stocks hypothesis tests; `hard` marks a new idea that is close in subject to a closed one (same data or the same kind of signal)

rules: No text names a frozen family or a trial id: those are decided by the name rule (findings-policy v2), not by the embedding. The measurement reports any text the name rule matches and leaves it out.
The split is fixed here: `calibration` chooses the threshold, `validation` only reports it. Nothing is moved between splits after the measurement.
H3 (never executed), H20, H21 and H22 have no content in the sources beyond their state; no text targets them, but they stay in the closed set the texts are compared against.
H17, H18 and H19 are PAUSED (not closed): texts on accruals, E/P and B/M are labelled new.
